entry.title: New: Bill 56 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM, GENERAL, PAUKUKALO PARK FENCING" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, Office of the Mayor, Economic Development Program, General to delete “Department of Hawaiian Home Lands” and insert “Paukukalo Hawaiian Home Community Association, Inc.”.
